headword: {無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}

definitions.explanation: Time off from work during which the employee does not receive salary or wages. Taken for personal reasons, extended absences, or when paid leave has been exhausted.

examples.japanese: {無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I took unpaid leave and went overseas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{切|き}った→使い切る：11518_tsukaikiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}した→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Since I used up all my paid leave, I applied for unpaid leave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{認|みと}められている→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: Under company regulations, unpaid leave is allowed for up to three months.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{無給|むきゅう}→無給：21904_mukyuu⟧ (without pay) + ⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧ (leave, vacation). The opposite is ⟦{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧ (paid leave), commonly abbreviated to {有休|ゆうきゅう} or ⟦{有給|ゆうきゅう}→有給：04552_yuukyuu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take unpaid leave
- {無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply for unpaid leave
- {無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: unpaid leave is approved
- ⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧{無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}: extended unpaid leave

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧: paid leave (leave during which salary continues)
- ⟦{休職|きゅうしょく}→休職：18305_kyuushoku⟧: leave of absence (formal suspension from duties, often for health reasons)
- ⟦{欠勤|けっきん}→欠勤：07732_kekkin⟧: absence from work (unscheduled, often implies not approved in advance)
